args.description: karate side thrust kick: turns sideways and thrusts the heel straight forward at chest height, then back. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves her), always facing right, seen from the side; keep her look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what she holds: no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture.
